feed.title: Google Cloud: App Engine flexible environment Python
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: App Engine flexible environment Python

entry.content: Starting from August 2026, to provide modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later, the App Engine flexible environment uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 as the built-in sidecar container for connections to Cloud SQL. To use the latest Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container immediately, restart your VMs or deploy a new version of your application.
entry.summary: App Engine flexible environment now uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 for secure connections to Cloud SQL, supporting MySQL 8.4 and later. This update provides modern security patches and ensures compatibility with upcoming MySQL versions. You can enable the latest proxy by restarting your VMs or deploying a new application version.
entry.title: Feature: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 for App Engine

entry.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: App Engine is upgrading to TLS 1.2 and later in August 2026 to enhance security. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine TLS 1.2 Upgrade

entry.content: Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using the gcloud beta app migrate-to-run command is in Preview. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run.
entry.summary: You can now migrate your existing App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is currently in Preview, allowing for a more flexible deployment option for your apps. For detailed instructions, refer to the migration guide.
entry.title: Feature: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run

entry.summary: The Python 3.14 runtime is now generally available for use. This feature provides enhanced capabilities and support for your Python applications.
entry.title: Feature: Python 3.14 runtime now available

entry.summary: Python 3.14 runtime is now available for use in preview.
entry.title: Feature: Python 3.14 runtime now in preview

entry.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. Update your application settings in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).
entry.summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated starting March 2025. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.
entry.title: Feature: TLS 1.1 Deprecation
